NEXT SEMESTER, THE CAMPUS FITNESS CENTER WILL OFFER
A SERIES OF RECREATIONAL CLASSES IN IYENGAR YOGA.
Iyengar yoga is distinct from other forms of yoga familiar to many
people. Various forms of vinyasa—“flow yoga”—are popular today.
If you have taken yoga classes, you have probably experienced this
approach, which involves moving from pose to pose with minimal
pauses. Iyengar yoga takes a more deliberate approach: Teachers
demonstrate poses, emphasizing alignment and precision, and then
instruct students with clear, specific language.
Developed by B.K.S. Iyengar (1918–2014), Iyengar Yoga is grounded
in the ancient Indian tradition and philosophy of Patanjali’s
Yoga-sutras. A master teacher himself, Iyengar became a highly
influential teacher of teachers, creating a rigorous system of training
and certification. Iyengar teachers are skilled in helping students
develop strength, flexibility, and concentration. Their approach
provides a safe way to learn yoga poses and accommodates students
with physical limitations.
Introduction to Iyengar Yoga: Tues/Thurs 5:00 P.M.–6:30 P.M.
